subject: Invoice submission: portal vs email — invoice template & PO matching
messages:

Cc: finance@nimbuslogistics.com
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice submission & template — Redwood PO 12345?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call last week. We have our first invoice ready for PO 12345 (attached). A couple quick questions before we submit formally:

- Do you prefer invoices submitted into your vendor portal or via email to an AP inbox?
- Is a consolidated weekly invoice acceptable or do you require per-shipment invoices that reference the line-level PO?
- Our template currently lists product codes in a single column; do you need a separate unit price and quantity columns for 2-way/3-way matching?

Attached: Nimbus_Invoice_20260301.pdf (PDF)

If email is okay for the first payment, please confirm the exact email alias and any subject/PO formatting required so we can avoid delays.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission & template — Redwood PO 12345?

Hi Tanya — great to hear from you and thanks for sending the sample invoice. High level: Redwood prefers that vendors use our vendor portal (vendor-portal.redwood.ai) for all new suppliers to ensure PO matching and automated remittance. That said, we can accept email submissions during the onboarding window (first 30 days) if you need time to complete the portal invite.

Portal advantages:
- Automatic PO matching (please include PO number exactly as "PO-12345" in the PO field)
- CSV line-item import for 3-way match
- Faster payment cycle when matched

Email fallback (temporary):
- Send to vendor-invoices@redwood.ai
- Put the PO number in the subject like: "Invoice PO-12345 — Nimbus Logistics"
- Attach a PDF and a CSV of line items (CSV column order: line_description, sku, qty, unit_price, tax, line_total)
- Include your company tax ID and remittance bank details in the body or an attachment

Regarding consolidated invoices: we can accept weekly consolidation only if each consolidated file contains the PO and shipment-level detail for each line. Monthly consolidated invoices are allowed only for recurring services with a separate statement of work — otherwise payments will be delayed.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) and an example invoice CSV template (invoice_template_example.csv). Dev, Lauren — tagging you for PO matching rules and any additional fields we should call out to Tanya.

Next steps for Nimbus:
1) Fill and return the onboarding form (link in attachment).
2) We'll send a portal invite within 48 business hours after we receive the completed form.
3) If you need to email an invoice in the meantime, use the vendor-invoices alias and include both PDF + CSV as described above.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (stub), invoice_template_example.csv (stub)

Subject: Re: Invoice submission & template — Redwood PO 12345?

Marissa — thanks for the clear guidance. A couple follow-ups from our AP team after reviewing your CSV sample: 

1) We currently send per-shipment invoices, but on high-volume lanes we compress to weekly files that reference multiple POs. Will the portal accept a single CSV with multiple PO numbers in the PO column?
2) Our tax ID in the W-9 is "35-6789012" but our invoices sometimes print it with dashes removed. Will that block the match?
3) We need the portal invite; can you confirm the email you will invite (accounts@nimbuslogistics.com) and whether the invite will include SSO options?

Attached is a revised invoice that includes separate qty/unit price columns (Nimbus_Invoice_20260301_v2.pdf). We can also export CSVs matching your sample once we receive the portal layout.

Appreciate the quick turnaround here — our AR manager wants to avoid payment delays on the first invoice.

Best,
Tanya

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Reed <accounts@nimbuslogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission & template — Redwood PO 12345?

Hi Tanya — looping in from Procurement. Quick answers: 

- The portal accepts CSVs with multiple PO numbers; each row must include the PO column so our matcher can reconcile line-items to the correct PO. Consolidated CSVs are fine as long as every line item maps to a PO.
- Tax ID formatting (dashes vs none) will not block matching; our backend normalizes common patterns. That said, please include the W-9 tax id in the onboarding form so we have the canonical value.
- We'll send the vendor portal invite to accounts@nimbuslogistics.com and the invite will support SSO via Google Workspace. Expect the invite within 48 business hours after we receive your completed onboarding form and W-9.

A couple of policy items to avoid delays: 
1) PO matching rules: exact PO ("PO-12345"), or supplier-provided mapping in the CSV PO column. If the PO is missing, the invoice will be routed to manual review and payment will be delayed.
2) Required invoice fields: invoice number, invoice date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), PO number, line description, sku, qty, unit_price, tax_amount, line_total, invoice_total, remittance_bank_name, remittance_account_last4, supplier_tax_id.
3) Supporting docs: attach delivery receipts or BOLs when invoicing for freight/shipments.

Once we receive your completed form, Marissa will confirm the DocuSign for the vendor agreement; we require the vendor agreement signed for net-60 terms. If you'd prefer net-30, note that requires an approved exception and may affect early payment timing.

Thanks — excited to get Nimbus fully onboarded.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
attachments: redwood_vendor_agreement_docusign.pdf (stub)
